rules.message: Every mirrored width input needs a name (w-<col>) — the autosave serializes it.
Persisting a preference is a mutation — the prefs form POSTs (data-hx-post).
Autosave rides the resize event: data-hx-trigger must listen for hc:datagridcolumnresize (debounced).
data-hx-include="this" keeps the request to the mirrored inputs — the grid itself is not a form payload.
Announce saves: target a role="status" fragment.
